theme.title: Quiet Session
theme.summary: Energy (+0.31%) and Technology (+0.22%) led the market today, while Consumer Discretionary (-0.35%) and Utilities (-0.14%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged -0.06%, defensives -0.05%, and value/cyclicals +0.05% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.32%, Dow +0.30%, Nasdaq +0.66% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps moved roughly in line with the broader market, with the Russell 2000 at +0.50%. The VIX rose 1.04% to 15.61, pointing to a bit more caution creeping in beneath the surface. Gold slipped 0.57% to $4,674.20, crude oil was little changed at $80.33, and bitcoin slipped 0.39% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
